title: square in a square
author: Debi Y (hooksandyarns)
notes: Start: original Rnd 1 works into a chain ('ch 4, 2 dc in 4th ch from hook, ... in same ch') rather than a ring; recorded as a magic ring (first line added, Round 1 text kept as published). 'Rnd N:' normalised to 'Round N:'. Rnds 1-2 are a small granny; Rnd 3 bridges each side with a ch-5 loop and Rnd 4 turns those loops into the new corners (square rotated 45 degrees). Page footer: 'please, do not sell the pattern and do not claim my patterns as your own' (no ban on sharing the text). Stitch graph: round 5 reads badly (cost 14.0); check where its stitches go.
